'''furhead16 Dark Political Red''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[furhead16]]
* '''Published:''' 2 December 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Theme/Fun
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Coruscant: Galactic Senate|Cor-D-coruscantgalacticsenate.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Coruscant: Galactic Senate
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PCor Coruscant Galactic Senate furhead1.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This deck has some political influence, and then nothing but cheap interrups and effects to make your opponent lose.  Started off as a joke, then I tried to tweak it.

== Strategy ==

First off, you are going to start with the Senate chambers.  The characters that aren't politicians are there to try and hold one or two other locations.  Arica is there to stop a drain at a site where your opponent is draining for 4 with half the Rebel army.  Plop her down and the drain is dead.  3 star destroyers to hold one planet.  Tatooine is for gravel storm, and Hoth for Ice storm.  Use all the other effects and interrupts to make your opponent lose cards every turn.

I don't have a whole lot of cards, so this is the best I could do with what I have.
